verdict: Leads surged this week; overdue milestones must close before we can scale.
narrative: This period you received 21 leads at a blended cost of $74.95 per lead — a sharp improvement driven entirely by Meta, which delivered all 21 leads as the campaigns matured. Google Ads ran $971.05 in spend over the last 28 days but returned no attributable leads, with your top campaign (BWS-Heating-Search-Calls) absorbing nearly half of that budget; Google's attribution setup is being reviewed now so spend is tied to results. Your Google Business Profile went dark on organic actions over the last seven days, and that is being addressed this week. Several planned milestones — including heating campaign activation, fall creative, and LSA re-enable — are overdue, and closing those is the immediate priority before any budget increase moves forward.
